comment: Machine-readable shape of BUGS.json at skill version 2.0.0-alpha.1. Read this when a BUGS.json records a different skill_version than the installed skill: there is no backwards compatibility, so the agent holding the file upgrades it or rewrites it.

title.note: the defect in one line, stated as what goes wrong

invariants: every parent names an existing id
a fixed entry has a verification
a confirmed entry has a mechanism

1.4.2.describes: A bug register written by skill version 1.4.2.
steps: jq '.skill_version = "2.0.0-alpha.1"' BUGS.json > BUGS.json.tmp && mv BUGS.json.tmp BUGS.json

if_no_schema_for_a_version: Rewrite the file from the current schema rather than guessing the difference. Carry every reproduction across verbatim: it is the one field that cannot be reconstructed later.
